profile: direct-event v1 / Codex CLI 0.155.1 / Linux arm64 / headless command hooks / controlled writer

obligations.policy: Adapt successful pinned Add with explicit identity/root; narrowly corroborate Update and preserve independent multi-file outcomes.
checks: adapts the pinned Codex 0.155.1 native event fixture
preserves the complete explicit recipient and canonical Git root
selects only an Update root uniquely corroborated by a nonempty added line
revalidates delayed Add, Update, and multi-file work through deterministic backend gates

obligations.policy: Reject malformed/failed/missing-identity input, commands above 64 KiB, candidate counts outside 1–16, and unsupported operations without wrong-path capture.
checks: quietly rejects missing identity, failure, and bounds
accepts exactly 64 KiB and rejects one byte above
does not capture metadata-only, Delete, or move candidates even if paths exist
claims unsupported native apply_patch events without legacy review work

obligations.policy: Delivery-only Bash hooks collect accepted advice and create zero new capture/backend work.
checks: routes a native controlled-writer Codex Add through direct-event stdout

obligations.policy: Honor nested Git ignores and tracked semantics while ignoring info/global excludes.
checks: honors nested .gitignore for untracked files and tracked semantics
does not load .git/info/exclude or global excludes

obligations.policy: Highest includes replace, exclusions accumulate/win, hard gates cannot be overridden, and ordinary build/generated/vendor names stay selectable.
checks: applies replacement includes, accumulated exclusions, and the hard floor
exclusion monotonicity holds for bounded generated policies

obligations.policy: Enforce containment, .env/node_modules/Git-admin, symlink and nonregular gates before reads with zero backend calls; only named paths are considered.
checks: does zero source reads and backend calls for excluded paths
enforces every selection gate before source reads and backend work
rejects symlink traversal and nonregular paths before capture
rejects the structured in-root Git directory without prefix overreach

obligations.policy: Accept stable repeated UTF-8/BOM capture through exactly 32 KiB; contain oversized, malformed UTF-8 and NUL/binary input.
checks: accepts matching reads, BOM, and the exact byte limit
contains oversize, malformed UTF-8, and NUL input

obligations.policy: Contain mutation, deletion/recreation, disappearance/nonregular replacement, and cancellation without mixed evidence.
checks: contains mutation and deletion/recreation between reads
contains disappearance and a change to nonregular after selection
is interruptible without returning capture evidence

obligations.policy: Parser/applicability failures are quiet; independent valid paths proceed inside an incomplete observation, never a complete parent ChangeSet.
checks: keeps analyzer failures incomplete with their reasons and no ChangeSet
keeps unsupported analyzer input quiet with no backend call
keeps valid work in an incomplete mixed-file observation without a ChangeSet

groups.boundary: named-unit extraction and one request per unit

obligations.policy: Extract unique named roots with finite same-file expanded/included/omitted evidence.
checks: extracts independent roots with finite recursive expanded and included evidence
records omitted evidence and never promotes missing or unsupported references

obligations.policy: Accept exactly 64 declarations and exactly 16 referenced names excluding root; reject the next item.
checks: accepts exactly 64 declarations and rejects the 65th
accepts exactly 16 referenced names excluding the root and rejects the 17th

obligations.policy: Reject imports, merging, schema-only, unresolved/qualified evidence call-free; make one request per complete unit and emit no empty advice.
checks: rejects imports, declaration merging, and unsupported schema-only files
rejects qualified and value-query references without a backend call
sends one request per Add unit with recursive supporting evidence
emits no empty advice after a successful clear

obligations.policy: Identity excludes event IDs and includes partition, path, evidence, contract and immutable rules; equivalent pending inputs join before another reservation independently of cache.
checks: excludes event ids while including partition, path, evidence, contract, and immutable rules
joins equivalent pending complete inputs before another evaluation reservation

obligations.policy: Reuse only successful complete results; never failure/malformed output; bound LRU to 8 entries/128 KiB without disturbing pending joins.
checks: reuses successful clear evaluations but never failures or malformed responses
evicts successful LRU entries without disturbing pending joins
bounds successful reuse by entry and byte limits and reevaluates evicted input

obligations.policy: Restore A after A-B-A without delivery history and isolate child/recipient/root partitions.
checks: restores cached A after A to B to A without retaining delivery history
retains child identity and rejects malformed observations after bounded framing

obligations.policy: Preserve advice across unrelated comments/siblings; stale relevant declaration/reference/rule/selection/contract changes with no whole-file fallback.
checks: allows unrelated file-context edits but suppresses relevant semantic changes
suppresses handoff on deletion, analyzer loss, or rule identity change
retires advice when recursive supporting evidence changes

obligations.policy: Unavailable identity and late/superseded completions never publish or delete newer work; revalidation reads only retained units.
checks: never publishes a late completion superseded while its backend call is gated
does not let late A cleanup delete C after cached-clear B removes current state
recaptures only paths and units retained for publication

obligations.policy: Matching reads do not prove authorship; absent controlled-writer authority or recipient mismatch emits no addressed advice.
checks: requires controlled-writer authority and exact recipient association

obligations.policy: Dispatch a lone item promptly, use finite keyed FIFO cycles under arrivals, and cap backend concurrency at two.
checks: dispatches an idle lone item immediately and puts sustained later arrivals in later cycles
carries keyed FIFO sequence metadata and reports finite cycle completion
never exceeds two running backend operations

obligations.policy: Collect on cycle completion or exact 50 ms oldest-result age.
checks: becomes eligible at cycle completion or exactly 50 ms without resetting age
uses finite-cycle completion, then exact oldest-result aging, without waiting for new work

obligations.policy: Deterministically return at most five flattened items/2 KiB, retain overflow, and prevent notices displacing findings.
checks: enforces five items and the exact 2 KiB host encoding
shares item and byte bounds without allowing notices to displace findings
combines five deterministic items and retains count overflow for a later reply

obligations.policy: Expire at 600,000 ms equality with before/at/after coverage.
checks: expires pending advice just before, at, and after the relevance boundary

obligations.policy: Enforce global 64/8 MiB and partition 16/2 MiB equality/excess across ingress, preparation and exact unit replacement.
checks: enforces the profile's exact 64/8MiB and 16/2MiB boundaries
accepts exact byte boundaries, rejects one byte over, and releases idempotently
resizes preparation workspace and atomically replaces it with exact units

obligations.policy: Reserve queued/running/cache/outcome/advice/duplicate/notice state before work; reject explicitly without evicting accepted fresh outcomes.
checks: reserves large valid outcomes before evaluation and rejects unreservable outcomes without a call
bounds 16-path/64-unit preparation and accounts accepted units exactly

obligations.policy: Bound IPC before decoding/writing and reject malformed/oversized output before retention.
checks: rejects an oversized request before writing recipient-bearing bytes
rejects malformed and oversized unknown output before retention

obligations.policy: Release reservations on every terminal path; logical ledger evidence makes no RSS guarantee.
checks: clears all reservations at a lifecycle terminal
releases promised outcome space after malformed backend output

obligations.policy: First failure eligible; same kind/partition suppressed before 60,000 ms and eligible at equality; no timer-only emission; restart resets.
checks: uses an exact failure-triggered cooldown and resets state on restart

obligations.policy: Capacity/backend kinds and recipient/root partitions remain independent with optional suppressed counts.
checks: keeps capacity/backend and recipient partitions independent and batches with fresh findings

obligations.policy: Bound cooldown state, preserve active suppression under full-table pressure from another eligible key, never recurse/displace findings, and never address unknown/quiet outcomes.
checks: reclaims a full cooldown table at equality before the next admission
preserves active suppression under full-table pressure from another eligible key
does not address unknown recipients or quiet applicability outcomes

obligations.policy: Converge 100 starters/eight processes with lazy init; reject unsafe/stale/symlink endpoints and recover losing-owner races.
checks: converges 100 starters across eight clients and keeps timed-out/disconnected work resident-owned
rejects wrong ownership, unsafe mode, symlinks, and wrong endpoint types
retries owner acquisition after a losing owner exits within the same deadline

obligations.policy: Bound readiness to 10 s and all client operations to one 1.5 s deadline across uncertain IPC.
checks: uses one absolute readiness deadline and caps every operation to remaining time
bounds a collect response when the connected server never responds

obligations.policy: Client timeout/disconnect does not cancel accepted work; kill/restart loses memory, rejects obsolete messages, and cleanup refuses pending state.
checks: kills one lifetime, rejects obsolete messages, restarts empty, and cleans up only when idle
reclaims disconnected collection and unfinalized acknowledgement deterministically

obligations.policy: Distinct existing worktrees retain separate canonical root/consent identity.
checks: does not inherit a grant into a separate Git worktree and makes no provider call

obligations.policy: Enable via preview plus exact digest confirmation for canonical root/backend/destination/scope; project config cannot grant and disable affects future dispatch.
checks: previews exact consent scope without writing and rejects a mismatched confirmation
reuses a grant, ignores project authorization, and revokes future dispatch

obligations.policy: Recheck consent and current configuration immediately before resident backend dispatch.
checks: rechecks consent after admission and before backend dispatch
loads current configuration at dispatch rather than freezing admission config
rejects prepared work after a completed exclusion update
rechecks exclusion after the credential-to-dispatch wait

obligations.policy: Omitted credentials/consent make no paid request and cannot inherit across unrelated grants.
checks: preserves the completed edit and reports unavailable without credentials
retains unrelated well-formed grants without reusing or revoking them

obligations.policy: Controlled backend proves exact 15-second deadline and zero automatic retries.
checks: uses a 15-second deadline and performs zero retries
does not retry a backend failure

obligations.policy: Runner distinguishes clear, findings, pending findings, operational notices, combined output, and delayed completion; success requires source-free cache evidence.
checks: distinguishes findings, operational notices, combined output, and no output
requires source-free successful-evaluation evidence for clear and findings
distinguishes pending findings, operational failure, and delayed completion

obligations.policy: Paid-capable execution exits before credential lookup/provider-capable commands unless --execute-paid is present; without provider-boundary instrumentation exact provider attempts stay unknown and are never inferred from admission.
checks: refuses missing execute-paid before credential lookup or provider-capable commands
keeps provider attempts unknown after accepted or rejected admission
inspects credential presence without exposing the value
